title: Are Tech Billionaires Finally About to Face Accountability? Kara Swisher on the Blue Tsunami and Big Tech
author: John Harwood
content:
As Silicon Valley's biggest power players face growing scrutiny over their
ties to Donald Trump, their influence on government, and their AI ambitions,
could the massive Democratic wins of the midterms mean U.S. tech billionaires
are about to face a reckoning?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Veteran journalist **Kara Swisher** joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** for a
wide-ranging, no-holds-barred conversation about the fallout from Nvidia CEO
Jensen Huang's [scandal(s)](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-
news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout), Elon Musk's government
[meddling](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/20/elon-musk-democrats-
oversight-01127543), and the dangers of allowing a handful of tech executives
to wield enormous power with little oversight.
